name: Judge Run: Decision Traces and Their Late Grades
extraData: {"description":"The traces half of the judge run, saved so it does not have to be retyped. Both services are in scope on purpose. toy-world carries one trace per model, with one span per query stamped with augmentloop.decision.type and augmentloop.decision.difficulty. toy-world-outcomes carries the deferred reality grades, which arrive later, on their own traces, and span-link back to the route_choice decisions they judge rather than nesting under them. That is the shape worth opening a span to see: pick any toy-world-outcomes span and follow its link back to a decision that was recorded earlier and separately. It is also why the SigNoz service map cannot draw this relationship, since the dependency graph reads in-trace parent and child spans and never cross-trace links (docs/conventions.md section 10.1). Empty list means the same three causes as the metrics view: the replay has not run, the time range does not cover it, or OTLP was not up when it ran."}
